source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Wheels and Tires, p.10-2

procedures.title: Tire wear: diagnose
steps: A thin feather edge of rubber on one side of the tread confirms misalignment (see figure 1 in the manual); reset toe-in or recheck full front end alignment.

Heel and toe wear: tread blocks worn saw-tooth fashion, the leading (first to grip under braking) end worn more. Some is normal; it shows more on front tires since rears are also worn the opposite way by drive force.
Excessive heel and toe wear comes from fast driving and hard braking: advise the owner and rotate tires regularly.
notes: Figure 2 in the manual compares over- and under-inflation wear.
